_readme: Entity registry per docs/SPEC.md §15. Never hardcode public/private status elsewhere — read it from here. Verify public entities against SEC EDGAR (data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json, UA header required). Weekly registry sweep runs in the Saturday routine; entities with recheck_trigger 'EDGAR weekly sweep' get an EDGAR full-text/submissions re-check every Saturday. NEVER invent a price or valuation for a private company.

public.share_classes: dual (Class A traded, Class B 10x votes)
public.industry: Aerospace / launch / satellite communications / AI (absorbed xAI, incl. Grok and the X platform, in a $1.25T all-stock merger closed 2026-02-02, ahead of the June IPO)
public.note: CRITICAL: the ticker 'SPCX' belonged to the unrelated Tuttle ETF until 2026-04-07 (that fund is now SPCK). SpaceX price history begins 2026-06-12 — NEVER backfill earlier SPCX data. First quarterly report as a public company (Q2 2026, 8-K + 10-Q) filed 2026-08-04. SEC EDGAR classifies SPCX under a computer-programming/data-processing SIC code, not a pure aerospace code, consistent with the xAI merger.
